★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Tashi taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.

regDeaths.name: the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
a soft green glow under the water
